observations: Date start changes row-group boundary overlap. All six heldout 1-day windows have one candidate group; 7-day windows have four. This limits extrapolation to other date windows.
At N=30 for 7-day queries, median of paired differences is negative while difference of separate medians is positive. Both retained; preregistered paired comparison governs crossing.
Runtime variation is observed, but CPU scheduling/background activity causes were not measured; do not assert a specific cause.
